title: Joint Manager (Administration)
qualification: Essential Qualification: || A Master's degree from a recognized University || Operational computer knowledge || 4 years of experience, preferably in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies in the relevant area, at Pay Level 7/8 (Grade Pay Rs. 4600/4800) as per 7th CPC or its equivalent || Desirable Qualification: || MBA/CA/ICWA/SAS or equivalent || Proficiency in ERP systems, financial management software, and standard computer applications || Experience in administrative functions within a Government department, PSU, or Government organisation, OR experience in finance and accounting within a government system || Deep understanding of Government of India rules, CCS (Conduct) Rules, General Financial Rules (GFR), Delegation of Financial Powers Rules, and related instructions || Experience means relevant field experience acquired from a Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous/Research Organization after obtaining the minimum educational qualification, and must be supported by documentary proof clearly indicating duties performed and dates of joining and relieving.
salary: The Joint Manager (Administration) post carries Pay Level 10 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC). In addition to the basic pay, the post carries usual allowances such as Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Travelling Allowance (TA), Leave Travel Concession (LTC), Children Education Allowance, National Pension System (NPS), medical facilities, and leave, as admissible to Society employees from time to time. || The post is on a regular basis, with a minimum probation period of 2 years. The place of posting is currently NCPOR, Goa, with transfer liability to any part of India.
age_limit: The upper age limit for the Joint Manager (Administration) post is 40 years, reckoned as on the cut-off date of 20 August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable as follows: || As per Government of India norms for Ex-Servicemen and PwD candidates || Up to 5 years for persons serving on a regular basis in Government Organizations/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs, and employees working in NCPOR || Candidates seeking age relaxation must produce the relevant certificate in support of their claim.
application_fee: The official NCPOR recruitment notification (Advt. No. NCPOR/2026/06) does not specify any application fee details for the Joint Manager (Administration) post. Candidates are advised to check the official online application portal at the time of applying for any updates regarding application fee, if applicable.
selection_process: Selection for the Joint Manager (Administration) post will be based on screening of applications followed by an interview. Key points regarding the selection process include: || Mere fulfilment of the prescribed essential qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. || If a large number of applications are received, NCPOR may restrict the number of candidates called for interview based on desirable qualifications, academic performance, relevant experience, or any other benchmark decided by the screening committee. || NCPOR has full discretion to fix separate minimum criteria for shortlisting and interview. || Candidates working in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview. || Original certificates must be produced at the time of interview; non-production of originals will lead to disqualification.
